text:
NSH::context
Description
This command gets/sets the context header for NSH.
Syntax
NSH
::
context
NSH_CONTEXT_IDX
[
DIRECTION
CONTEXT
]
Examples
Set the context for NSH.
when
LB_SELECTED
{
NSH
::
context
1
serverside_egress
1111
set
myctx1
[
NSH
::
context
1
]
}
